name: Fantastic Stride
body:
Fantastic Stride (Ex)
Source Spymaster's Handbook pg. 27
The vigilante gains Spring Attack as a bonus feat, ignoring its prerequisites. At 10th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the vigilante can designate one additional creature when he uses Spring Attack. The vigilante’s movement this round does not provoke attacks of opportunity from any of these secondary creatures. A vigilante must be at least 6th level to select this talent.
